prompt: The owl on the branch slowly turns its head far round over its shoulder to look behind it, then slowly turns it back to the front. The body and the branch stay still. Static camera.
The owl slowly turns its whole head to the side, then back to face the camera, and blinks once. The body stays still. Static camera.
The small owl on the branch blinks and tilts its head slightly. The girl stands still looking up, her red scarf and the tall grass sway gently in the evening wind. Static camera.
